title: Dismiss a running asynchronous job and handle the removed resource
preconditions: The service advertises the OGC API - Processes Dismiss conformance class.
The process description advertises dismiss in jobControlOptions.

source.normalization: Job IDs and timestamps are templated.

must: Expose the server-side job independently from the local POST request.
must_not: Treat aborting the POST or a polling GET as dismissal of this job.

must: Expose dismissed as a terminal state and stop polling.
Preserve the DELETE response as the terminal job document.
must_not: Classify dismissal as a network abort or provider failure.

must: Return the parsed problem with status, headers, final URL, and raw body.
Retain the previously observed dismissed terminal state in the caller's job record.
must_not: Rewrite the earlier successful dismissal as if it never happened.

expect.profile_note: OGC Part 1 describes 410 Gone for repeated dismissal; this ZOO profile returns 404.

must: Expose the actual server problem without changing it to the status expected from another implementation.
must_not: Automatically retry DELETE after a definitive 404 response.
Treat the profile deviation as a transport failure.
